title: 救人命还能赚副业收入，他的飞机追踪App
title_en: Saving Lives with a Side Income: His Flight Tracking App
title_jp: 人命救助と副収入：彼の飛行機追跡アプリ
title_ar: إنقاذ الأرواح بدخل جانبي: تطبيق تتبع الطائرات الخاص به

{"ops": [{"insert": "救人命还能赚副业收入，他的飞机追踪App"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "业余项目变成了救命工具，他说：别过度工程化", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ernst Mulders从16岁左右开始，在学习和工作之外build东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Very product-minded person，just want build everything pops into mind。Always launching things on Product Hunt或App Store或Google Play。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "18岁时，做了time-tracking software记录working hours。很惊讶它made money。但以现在的知识，知道本可以更successful。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还做了travel website叫Seven Places，推荐similar vibe的bars或餐厅。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用Instagram pull popular posts about particular place，look at who posted，gather information about other locations they'd posted about。Do some algorithm stuff、suggest other similar places visit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Then Instagram killed API key after policy change。Platform risk。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "总是build products with money-making potential in mind。"}, {"insert": "AirAssist", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "是first time didn't think about it。想get to know React Native，needed idea work on。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Friend interested in Netherlands的trauma helicopters。有public network分享ambulances需要去哪的信息。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Made app display four或five different helicopters location every minute on gray map。Just demo project for self at this point，no monetization。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但users quickly found it、started asking for improvements。Now tracking over 550 different aircraft real-time。Can set time zones、get notified when aircraft fly past。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Built out international versions。在英国，有big incident notification if more than two aircraft respond to same area。这不是public information，often beat news agencies。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Had feedback form from start。After month or so got email from Netherlands hospital。Professionals using app，which hadn't anticipated。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Realized then needed look at monetization。Started placing ads in app，but didn't have that many users、didn't even cover server cost。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "So introduced one-off €2.99 option remove ads。Wife和他都thought nobody would pay for it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But that same day，people started buying it。After that，made sense put new features behind premium option。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Year in，thought probably need do something with subscriptions，because costs recurring。Upped pricing到around euro a month，€10 year和€20 lifetime。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Scary at first，but people started paying straight away。Last May，doubled prices again、people still paying。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Didn't really do any marketing。Netherlands人们search for messaging network，called P2000。So included in original Dutch app name。All App Store search optimization。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launching in UK和Germany lot harder because don't have specific word people searching for。Those countries grow more by word of mouth、people posting about it on social media。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Expand app country by country。Looking at France和Austria。Already in Switzerland、Luxembourg、Belgium。But hard expand。Have to get list of all relevant helicopters。When launch start out with zero users again。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Waterbomber", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " basically same thing，but for firefighting assets。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Got email from California someone who'd used AirAssist in early days。Said，'Wouldn't it be nice if could track all firefighting assets in air？'"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "At time，had look on Flight Radar或whatever，really hard filter。USA bigger market，so thought could be interesting。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But difficult challenge。Learnt hard way just how many firefighting assets flying around。Lot of stuff track。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App now in Europe和Australia too。Quite chore manually add every relevant aircraft。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Another daunting part：Canada有vast areas radar coverage really bad。Firefighting aircraft often fly very low to ground。Appear on radar for like 20-30 minutes then pop up somewhere completely different。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App itself fully React Native，built with start components in there。API all PHP driven with some Node.js microservices lingering around。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每周basis spend say like 10 hours in evenings、sometimes weekends working on apps。Lot of customer support in there、takes more time than initially anticipated。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lots of professional users、often reach out with feedback。Police officer contacted say app saved his team few minutes——and that helped save person's life。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Police often have land few miles away from particular incident，then drive doctor to actual site。Normally takes time get right location from dispatch。App can speed that process up。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Had more messages like that，about AirAssist actually used save people's lives。Incredible。Most fulfilling part。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Same with Waterbomber。Fire departments actively using it。Get messages from departments in Italy、Australia、USA telling how use it every day locate aircraft。So surprised，but really、really cool。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ultimately，indie hacking hobby、enjoy it，so can fit in around work。If had choose between watching Netflix和working on product，choose product every time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "End goal eventually work on it full-time。But happy with balance struck right now。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Indie hacking great because still doable with family。Doable with nine to five。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "九、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Didn't expect AirAssist take off。Sometimes unexpected thing works。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also say keep it simple。First version of app so rubbish but people still really liked it、started using it。"}, {"insert": "Don't over-engineer、don't wait too long launch。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Listen what users say。Sometimes so obvious to maker how stuff works。Turns out users see stuff differently because don't live with app every day。Listen to them。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And don't forget product only small part of what doing。Need monetize it、market it if ever going work。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ernst的故事是关于impact——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Side project → Saving lives。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Key insights——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Simple products can have big impact", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Monetization can come later", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Listen to users（hospitals using it！）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't over-engineer first version", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App Store SEO matters", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Word of mouth in new markets", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的是，"}, {"insert": "he built it for himself，but it helped others。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That's the best kind of product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: Saving lives and earning side income his airplane tracking App. Side project became life-saving tool he says do not over-engineer. Ernst Mulders started building things outside study and work around age 16. Very product-minded person just want build everything that pops into mind. Always launching things on Product Hunt or App Store or Google Play. At 18 made time-tracking software to record working hours. Was surprised it made money. But with current knowledge know could have been more successful. Also made travel website called Seven Places recommending similar vibe bars or restaurants. Used Instagram to pull popular posts about particular place look at who posted gather information about other locations they posted about. Do some.
content_jp: 救命还能赚副业收入他的飞机追踪App. 业余项目变成救命工具他说:不要over-engineer. Ernst Mulders从16岁左右开始在学习和工作之外build东西.非常product-minded的人，只是想build脑海中出现的所有东西.总是在Product Hunt或App Store或Google Play上launch东西. 18岁时做了time-tracking software记录working hours.很惊讶它made money.但以现在的知识知道本可以更successful.还做了travel website叫Seven Places推荐similar vibe的bars或restaurants.用Instagram pull popular posts about particular place看看谁post的gather information about other locations they'd posted about.做一些.
content_ar: إنقاذ الأرواح وكسب الدخل الجانبي تطبيق تتبع飞机的. المشروع الجانبي أصبح أداة تنقذ الحياة он говорит: не переусердствуй. Ernst Muldersبدأ يبني أشياء خارج الدراسة والعمل في حوالي 16. شخص molto product-minded يريد فقط بناء كل ما يخطر على باله. دائماً يطلق أشياء على Product Hunt أو App Store أو Google Play. في 18 сделал программу отслеживания времени для записи рабочих часов. был удивлён что она принесла деньги. но с текущими знаниями знает что мог бы быть более успешным. также сделал сайт путешествий называется Seven Places рекомендует подобные бары или рестораны. использовал Instagram чтобы получить популярные посты о конкретном месте смотрел кто публиковал собирал информацию о других местах которые они публиковали. сделать некоторые.
